decisions: No new directory: all three modules land beside their source in the existing src/calculator/champions package, so packages is empty.

The file's own three section banners are the concept lines, so the cut follows them: the modifier walk, the entry dicts, the control atoms. with_control, park_control_interval and with_control_event join the control atoms because a control archetype is what an atom is for.

slotlib.py keeps the remaining archetype factories and no re-export: about 150 champion modules import three names from three modules instead of one, which is the codemod scripts/module_readers.py runs.
Published spelling: slotlib reads both slot_control helpers across the boundary, so _resolve_casts is resolve_casts and _resolve_source is resolve_source.
